name: SkyWise
oneliner: A weather app you can talk to.
summary: SkyWise is a weather app for iPhone and Android with a built-in AI assistant. Alongside the forecast, you can ask plain questions like whether it is a good day for a barbecue or which shoes to wear.
description: Most weather apps give you numbers and leave the interpretation to you. SkyWise adds an assistant that answers the question you actually have: is it a good day for a barbecue, do I need a jacket tonight, which shoes should I wear.
Under the assistant is a full forecast: current conditions, an hourly forecast, and a weather map. The app themes itself to fit your style, in light and dark.
SkyWise is free to download on the App Store and Google Play.
